messages:
Priya: handing off — I'm offline-ish in 30m. Ongoing incident INC-3281: read-only fallback triggered on embedding-store (EU-WEST). Short summary: write errors + KV eviction spikes causing ~5-15% customer errors depending on shard. Mitigations in flight.

Priya: primary/secondary for the window:
- Primary: Priya (current)
- Secondary: Elliot (overlap until 18:00 UTC)
- Backup (DB perms): Sam

Priya: what we already did:
- scaled read replicas +2 (eu-west)
- applied throttling to non-critical jobs (queue: embeddings-index)
- reverted leader-election flag temporarily to reduce contention
- split 20% of traffic to us-west as short-term relief

Elliot: saw alerts and traces. KV eviction rate and p99 writes are the signal. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/readonly-fallback :point_up:

oncall-bot: ALERT INC-3281: embstore_write_errors > 5% (15m) — paging primary

Sam: heads up — I can do DB replica promotion but I don't have k8s/service account perms in eu-west to run the smoke check. Pinged infra.

Lena: infra update: temporary perms requested (ticket INF-1129). Infra estimates ~10m to grant.

Priya: current mitigation commands/references (already applied):
- throttle rule: `rbac.throttle.embeddings=0.6`
- disabled leader election: `kubectl -n emb set env deploy/emb-service LEADER_ELECTION=false` (applied at 1759999000)

Priya: quick logs snippet for context:
```
2025-06-12T17:30:10Z ERROR emb-writer: write_failed: timeout after 3s
2025-06-12T17:31:02Z WARN  kvstore: eviction_rate=0.73 p99=1.2s
```

Elliot: recommendation — hold the fallback for 45-60m while infra grants perms. If INF-1129 completes, Sam will run promotion: `psql -h eu-west-db-replica -c \"SELECT pg_promote()\"`

Sam: I'll be standing by. I will create a step-by-step log here before I run promotion so rollback is trivial.

Priya: coverage gaps to call out:
- no one with org-level billing perms to enable burst capacity (escalated to @ops-leads; no ETA)
- limited k8s SA owners in eu-west until INF-1129 resolves

Elliot: customer impact note: ~5% of EU-WEST requests see 429/503; account team is manually rerouting high-value customers for now. Monitor incident slack for any account asks.

Priya: Handoff checklist for incoming primary (Elliot):
- keep throttles in place
- monitor dashboards: `embstore_write_errors`, `kv_evictions`, `replication_lag`
- watch replication lag > 30s (if so, do NOT promote)
- if INF-1129 granted, Sam will promote and run smoke tests: `curl -sS https://internal-emb-smoke/eu-west/health` (expect 200)
- escalate to infra via INF-1129 and ops-leads for burst capacity INF-1130

Elliot: ack. I'll assume primary until 18:00 UTC. If promotion happens, I'll coordinate smoke tests and notify @pagerduty-bot and account teams.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Reminder: attach post-incident notes to INC-3281 after resolution.

Priya: left the throttle and route IDs in the docs channel: `throttle-emb-v3-euw`, `route-split-20pct-usw`. Off now — gl everyone :wave:

Elliot: taking it from here. Will update thread on any state changes or if we clear customer errors.
